title: Brazil Crop Fields (CONAB)
description:
CONAB, Brazil's National Supply Company, is the government agency responsible for providing information on the country's agricultural harvest.

These 29 mappings, after inspecting all boundaries in the CONAB public database, appear to be hand-drawn field boundaries.

The content of the Mappings comes from Conab, total or partial reproduction without profit motives is authorized,
as long as the source is cited and the integrity of the information is maintained.

Further information or suggestions can be sent to the email address conab.geote@conab.gov.br

This collection holds 1 edition (2026), one GeoParquet file per year under `year=<year>/` (hive layout). Read them all at once with the partition glob `s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/br_conab/year=*/*.parquet` (S3 through the Source Cooperative proxy, endpoint `https://data.source.coop`; plain https cannot expand `*`); the `data` asset is a copy of the latest edition (2026). Geometries are kept in the source CRS (EPSG:4674). Converted with [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli) into the [fiboa](https://github.com/fiboa/specification) schema; tested queries are in the collection's [AGENTS.md](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/br_conab/AGENTS.md).

Boundaries are mapped: an authority delineated them from imagery or survey, with no farmer's declaration behind them.

table:columns.name: admin_municipality_code
table:columns.description: Municipality code (source column `cd_mun`, per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: admin_municipality_name
table:columns.description: Municipality name (source column `nm_mun`, per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

partition:keys.name: year
partition:keys.description: Edition year of the source dataset (the converter variant). Not a column in the files; DuckDB adds it with hive_partitioning=true. Expand the glob through S3 (endpoint data.source.coop, path style); plain https has no listing.

data.title: Conab — latest edition (2026) (GeoParquet)
data.description: Byte-identical copy of `year=2026/br_conab.parquet`, kept at a stable path so `*/latest/*.parquet` selects the newest edition of every collection.

style-field-size.title: Field size (ha)
style-field-size.description: Fields shaded light to dark by area in hectares (metrics:area / 10 000). Stops at 0.5, 1, 2, 5 ha, the nice values nearest this dataset's 20th/40th/60th/80th percentiles so each class holds a similar share of fields.

style-outline.title: Field boundaries
style-outline.description: Every field in one colour with a thin outline; for reading the boundaries themselves.
